new_results.scope: For independent 3D product inputs with marginal densities <=1 and arbitrary invertible symmetric physical B, affine terms allowed, ||p||_inf <=16|det B|^(-1/2) sum_i sqrt(sum_j|B_ij|).
If singular values are 0<s1<=s2<=s3, then ||p||_inf <=48*3^(1/4)/sqrt(s1*s2); hence the complete n=3 target has universal bound <63.172.

On gradient shells of radius r, transversality costs O(r^-1) while the two-coordinate physical projection has area O(r^2), leaving O(r) and a convergent small-scale dyadic sum; in rank two the O(r) projection leaves O(1) per shell and logarithmic divergence.

For any invertible physical principal triple A[I,I], conditioning all other original coordinates gives the same cofactor/spectral local bound uniformly in induced affine terms and arbitrary outside couplings.
